filing_office: Alabama Secretary of State, Business Services
filing_fee_notes: Name reservation is separate. The official brochure lists name reservation at 25 by paper or 28 online.
registered_agent_rules: Designate one registered agent with a street address in Alabama; a P.O. box is not acceptable.
franchise_or_privilege_tax: Business privilege tax may apply. For tax years beginning after December 31, 2023, calculated tax of 100 or less is exempt and no business privilege tax return is required.
plain_english_summary: Reserve the name and file the Certificate of Formation. Check whether business privilege tax applies.
common_mistake: Leaving out the required name reservation certificate.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. LLCs do not file the corporate annual report; report name, due date and filing URL are not applicable. Direct online formation and name-search URLs, processing time, expedite options, publication rules and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed and are null.
